cli.remaining_owner: Python hosted dispatch, assembly and direct backend; standalone native executables are separately selected profiles

worker.remaining_owner: Python one-request stdio, optional raw request admission then HIAAgentService.call; external Rust process owner remains

service.remaining_owner: Python business handlers and tool dispatch; native policy helpers do not imply whole-service rewrite

journal.native_owner: Explicit current agent_journal v2 for raw request canonicalization/hash, admission, replay and phase/write decisions
journal.remaining_owner: Fixed SQLite effect adapter and other table/business policy remain hosted

store.remaining_owner: Artifact namespace, profiles, cursors, contexts, cost ledger, slots, versions and leases remain existing hosted SQLite owners

groups.name: execution_budget
groups.compatibility: Independent of the old request_journal owner; original SQLite schema and rows preserved; integrate create and evaluate claim/run/complete only; test ordinary journal and current native v2 journal separately
groups.qualification: Current-source full gates not yet run; default selection and whole-native qualification remain false

groups.name: artifact_namespace
groups.reason: Seven API namespace closure is tied to native byte publication and the v67 request-journal effect-connection/capability contract; current agent_journal v2 has different ownership and acknowledgement ABI

groups.name: request_journal
groups.reason: Overlaps current v2 request/cost/phase ownership. v67 retained effect capability state is not a drop-in replacement for current raw-JSON/canonicalization journal protocol

groups.name: retirement_state
groups.reason: Current hosted retirement owner remains; v67 native retained identity/pin/sequence state can be reused only with actual one-use effect, replacement, cleanup and callback-failure controls

groups.name: nominal_graph
groups.reason: Current five-owner/eleven-image composite route already owns these main-route layers. v67 object-identity/opaque-pool individual graph is an alternative ABI, not evidence that current product has no native nominal lowering

groups.name: native_helpers_worker_bindings
groups.reason: Reuse explicit helper whitelist and fixed admitted image bindings; must include current agent_journal v2 plus execution_budget, not arbitrary MANIFEST variables

groups.name: slot_ledger
groups.reason: Built from older 63fa2e baseline and does not contain final v67 custody merge. Whole-tree overwrite would regress unrelated graph/cache/source custody; service adopt/rollback and request-journal write compatibility require targeted integration
